2607.11175.title: The Path to Self-Evolving Clinical Systems: Scaling Medical Agents from Assistance to Autonomy
2607.11175.paper_summary: The growing ability of large language models and vision language models to jointly interpret and reason over images and text is reshaping medical agents, moving them from task specific predictors toward autonomous systems that perceive, reason, plan, remember, and act in clinical environments. This work departs from the capability first perspective of existing literature and instead begins from clinical deployment, asking what tasks, contamination resistant benchmarks, and interactive training environments are required before medical agents can be trusted in practice. Medical agents are formalized as sequential decision making systems under partial observability, together with a three level autonomy taxonomy spanning assisted, cooperative, and fully autonomous operation. The field is organized along a unified scaling spine consisting of framework scaling, capability scaling, and environment scaling. Within this framework, clinical environment scaling, the integration of tools, data, and clinical gyms, is identified as the most actionable yet underexplored direction for agents operating in PACS, EHR, and FHIR ecosystems. Clinical self evolution, where agents improve through interaction with their environments rather than parameter scaling alone, is further positioned as a key research frontier, drawing insights from self improving agents, agent gyms, and test time compute scaling. Applications across radiology, pathology, ophthalmology, and hospital workflows are examined together with deployment challenges including hallucination, cascading failures, and fairness. By consolidating more than 300 references, with particular emphasis on advances from 2025 to 2026, this work provides a roadmap toward trustworthy, self improving medical imaging systems for real clinical practice.
2607.11175.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型和視覺語言模型共同解釋和推理圖像與文本的能力不斷增強，正在重塑醫療代理，將其從特定任務的預測者轉變為能在臨床環境中感知、推理、計劃、記憶和行動的自主系統。這項工作從現有文獻的能力優先視角出發，轉而從臨床部署開始，詢問在醫療代理可以在實踐中被信任之前，需要哪些任務、抗污染的基準和互動訓練環境。醫療代理被形式化為在部分可觀察性下的序列決策系統，並伴隨著涵蓋輔助、合作和完全自主操作的三層自主性分類法。該領域沿著統一的擴展脊柱組織，包括框架擴展、能力擴展和環境擴展。在這個框架內，臨床環境擴展，即工具、數據和臨床健身房的整合，被確定為在PACS、EHR和FHIR生態系統中運作的代理最具可行性但尚未深入探索的方向。臨床自我演進，即代理通過與其環境的互動而非僅僅通過參數擴展來改善，進一步被定位為一個關鍵的研究前沿，從自我改善代理、代理健身房和測試時計算擴展中汲取見解。本文檢視了放射學、病理學、眼科和醫院工作流程中的應用，以及包括幻覺、級聯故障和公平性在內的部署挑戰。通過整合超過300個參考文獻，特別強調2025年至2026年的進展，這項工作提供了一條通往值得信賴的、自我改善的醫學影像系統在實際臨床應用中的路線圖。
